status: completed bounded adjudication set; pending independent human review
unit: Pair of source-specific event claims, identified by production candidate_id = event_id::source_id

adjudication.method: Manual claim-level review of reviewed production event records and source evidence summaries; no inferred labels from arbitrary co-association alone. No independent human adjudication is claimed.
adjudication.scope: Diagnostic development set, not random sample or unseen held-out benchmark.
adjudication.article_identity_note: Different source records do not prove distinct underlying articles. same_underlying_article is null unless both claims use the identical source record. Print/web equivalence and syndication require a separate content comparison.
adjudication.leakage_warning: Event IDs, shared cluster membership, canonical summaries and adjudicated reasons reveal labels. Use IDs only to look up documents; do not supply them as matching features.

unscored_cases.reason: Contemporaneous cabinet approval report versus later NITI feature about establishment and operation; source association is broader context, not a duplicate approval report.
Signing account versus later inauguration report recalling the agreement; cannot label whole documents as duplicate reports of signing.
Inauguration report versus 2026 funding/modalities circular with retrospective launch reference.
Action-plan news versus later implementation-cell circular used to verify resolution date.
Budget report versus later sanction order recalling the budget announcement.
Policy resolution versus document index with conflicting date metadata. Index is not an article report.
Launch release versus current undated portal. Live portal corroborates existence, not an independent launch report.
Parliament dates the agreement September 2025; PIB describes a January 2026 ceremony without resolving renewal or expansion. Do not force an event-equivalence gold label for these documents.

limitations: Reviewed corpus selection is not a representative sample of news traffic.
Some positive pairs may share a press release or cabinet briefing; event equivalence is not independent corroboration.
One source can contain several events; document identity and event identity must remain separate.
No performance metrics have been computed or asserted.
Source ledger stores evidence summaries, not necessarily complete article snapshots; extraction testing requires separately captured document text.
Labels are researcher-assigned and revisable when instruments, dates or scopes are clarified.
